Class CameraIntersectionIntegration

java.lang.Object
renderer.CameraIntersectionIntegration
public class CameraIntersectionIntegration extends Object
Integration tests for Camera rays and Geometry intersections. These tests ensure that rays constructed by the camera correctly intersect scene geometries.
